text: OK I have a model in live view. it says unsaved edits. im trying to save it after doing a handful of edits, and it is not bringing up the dialog to let me store the live state

events.text: Diagnosed the live Save refusal without mutating the resident model: LIVE has 3 host-coherent Outliner ranges and 1,167 triangles, while the durable RJMD still owns 4 parts and 881 triangles. writeMeshDoc correctly refused the unapproved part-count shrink, but AppFrame collapsed that guard into the generic 'model artifacts were not written' status and never opened the LIVE/DISK picker. The cart now preflights that exact durable/live part mismatch, shows both part counts in the existing conflict surface, and makes Keep LIVE mint only a one-shot allowPartShrink capability for the disclosed replacement. Focused paint-conflict and meshdoc tests pass; full editor bundle passes. Awaiting the user's in-place Save/Keep LIVE visual verification.

resolution: Save now preflights the same destructive part-count condition enforced at the RJMD write boundary. When LIVE owns fewer Outliner parts than DISK and no explicit Delete/Merge capability survived, AppFrame opens the existing LIVE/DISK conflict surface instead of falling through to 'model artifacts were not written.' The surface states the exact part deletion, shows live and saved part counts, and Keep LIVE grants a one-shot allowPartShrink permission scoped to that disclosed choice; Keep DISK remains the ordinary destructive reload. Paint-layout behavior and semantic-clear authorization remain intact. Verified with 6 paint-conflict tests, 14 meshdoc persistence tests, full editor bundle, and diff checks; user was asked to exercise Save then Keep LIVE against the resident 1,167-triangle / 3-part model.
